label: Pixel 7 smartphone
description: Google Pixel 7 — 6.3-inch Tensor G2 phone, Wi-Fi 6E and 5G sub-6 GHz (mmWave on US carrier SKUs); USB-C with Ethernet adapter support.
notes: Wi-Fi 6E (802.11ax, 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, HE160). Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz by default; mmWave only on the US carrier-locked Pixel 7 SKU, so model EU units as sub-6. USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 supports Ethernet adapters (usb0).
